title: Validation redesign after ID329 public non-improvement

id329.role: guarded practical candidate; safe but no public improvement

new_primary_goal: First obtain a reproducible Public < 0.60 signal; Public 0.55 remains aspirational until validation explains ID178/ID287/ID329.
hard_constraints_before_new_submission: No same-family ID330/ID331 constrained-combo submission without a new decision note explaining why ID329 feedback does not apply.
No local-frontier candidate may be promoted solely because local CV improves; ID287 makes that invalid.
Every candidate must report distance to ID178, distance to ID329, projection to ID287 failed direction, local CV, and artifact family.
A candidate must be uniquely named and matched across submission CSV, notebook, submission_log, metadata JSON, and base predictions before review.

redesigned_validation_layers.name: Layer 0: artifact eligibility
redesigned_validation_layers.purpose: Reject candidates whose provenance or file contract is unclear before considering score.

redesigned_validation_layers.name: Layer 1: strict local validation
redesigned_validation_layers.purpose: Use only fold-safe OOF from subject-aware splits; no full-OOF residual recombination as proof.

redesigned_validation_layers.name: Layer 2: public-anchor geometry gate
redesigned_validation_layers.purpose: Screen candidate movement using known public outcomes without pretending this is ground truth.

redesigned_validation_layers.name: Layer 3: anchor-consistency audit
redesigned_validation_layers.purpose: A validation proxy is not trusted unless it qualitatively explains ID178 ~= ID329 << ID287 on Public.
checks: ID329 same-family local gain is discounted
ID178 remains a valid near-0.601 anchor

redesigned_validation_layers.name: Layer 4: pre-registered submission decision
redesigned_validation_layers.purpose: Allow only one public probe after the above layers produce a specific reason to expect Public < 0.60.

next_experiments_no_submission.name: Demographic/static-feature strict CV audit
next_experiments_no_submission.rationale: Untracked demographic features from the ETRI paper may be useful, but they must be evaluated under strict subject-hole validation before any public use.
next_experiments_no_submission.success_criteria: Improves strict fold-safe CV by target without increasing anchor-geometry risk; produces OOF/test artifacts only after review.

next_experiments_no_submission.name: Public-anchor geometry reranker
next_experiments_no_submission.rationale: Existing candidate artifacts can be re-ranked using ID178/ID329 anchors and ID287 failed vector without making new predictions.
next_experiments_no_submission.success_criteria: Produces a short ranked list where ID330/ID331 are not automatically promoted and at least one candidate has a distinct family rationale.

next_experiments_no_submission.name: Source/report promotion audit
next_experiments_no_submission.rationale: The repo has 84 untracked scripts and 600+ bulk reports; authoritative artifacts must be separated from scratch outputs.
next_experiments_no_submission.success_criteria: A commit/branch-ready list of files to promote, archive, or delete; no modeling side effects.

submission_stop_rule: Stop same-family submissions after one negative public feedback event unless a new validation layer predicts the observed failure/non-improvement.
